chart.title: Mean body mass index (BMI) in men
chart.subtitle: Body mass index (BMI) is measured as a person's weight in kilograms (kg) divided by his height (in meters), squared. The WHO define a BMI <=18.5 as 'underweight'; 18.5 to <25 as 'normal/healthy'; 25.0 to <30as 'overweight'; and >30.0 as 'obese'.
